name: Bujo
author: IpastorSan
description: A bullet journal in the bar. Tasks belong to a day; migrate what you didn't finish.

barWidget.description: Dated task list with a calendar, completion stats, and one-click migration.

schema.label: Bar shows
schema.description: What the pill displays for today: done/total, tasks left, percent, or the icon alone.

schema.label: Week starts on
schema.description: Leave on locale to follow your system's first day of the week.

schema.label: Dim the icon when today is empty
Mark tasks that have been migrated
schema.description: Shows how many times a task has been pushed forward.

schema.label: Task file
schema.description: Leave empty for ~/.local/state/omarchy/bujo/tasks.json. Point it at the same synced folder on two machines and they share one journal: changes are merged, not overwritten. See the README section 'Using it on more than one device'.
